integrity: The proof isolates the published structural ingredients from the new enumeration: the 2023 paper supplies the N3 class decomposition and its automorphism group, the 2000 paper supplies the exact local-order count, and a separate finite replay independently checks the odd-bracelet Burnside formula and the self-converse corollary.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns orbits on finite subsets, not ordered tuple orbits.
Binary-bracelet enumeration is standard; originality is claimed for the exact N3 orbit identification and its local-order consequence.
The originality assessment cannot exclude unpublished folklore or older material indexed under substantially different terminology.
title: Odd-bracelet orbit profile of the set-homogeneous hypergraph N3
